messages:
mira: Heads-up — planning a soft unpin for SDK 3.2.1 on the nightshift window (02:00 UTC). This is timed to let canary run overnight. Need runtime + model teams to ack compatibility and fallback routing.
jonathan: ack, will run the extended canary suite at 01:30 UTC. I'll post telemetry pointers. :eyes:
deploybot: Scheduled: soft-unpin SDK v3.2.1 -> target window 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z. Canary cohort: eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1. Auto-fallback enabled.
samir: What are the rollback/abort criteria? CPU/GPU errors? regression in token latency? need thresholds.
mira: Good Q. Proposing immediate abort if 5%+ increase in 95th lat or 2x error rate for inference endpoints over 10m window. Also abort on any OOMs or KV cache corruption traces.
ops-elena: Also add customer-impact filter: any spike impacting Dedicated customers' SLAs => stop immediately and notify CS.
jonathan: I'll add a smoke check for top-50 routes and a live diff on token cost. If canary delta > 10% token cost increase, hold.
qa-liz: Test matrix: regression tests + structured-output fuzzing + replayed prompts from the last 24h eval set. I can kick off replay at 00:45 UTC and post a summary by 01:25.
mira: Please paste the replay command so others can run locally if needed.
qa-liz: Command (internal):
```
./tools/replay_prompts --source s3://canary-replays/last24h.json --sdk-version 3.2.1 --run-id ns-561234
```
Will upload results to /tmp/canary-3-2-1-summary.json
deploybot: Reminder: pinlist changes will be rolled out gradually. If teams request sticky-pin, use `deploybot pin-sticky <model|runtime|sdk>` to opt-out of soft-unpin.
samir: If we see sticky-pin requests from dedicated customers during the window, what's the fast path for rollback?
mira: Fast path: stop unpin job, spawn immediate rollback for the cohorts (deploybot rollback <job-id>), revert routing to previous SDK shard, and mute canary traffic. ops to notify CS and account owners.
ops-elena: I'll prepare the CS blurb template and escalation list. postmortem owners: @mira + @jonathan.
jonathan: telemetry endpoints for the canary dashboard: `/internal/telemetry/canary/sdk/3.2.1` and `/internal/alerts/canary/3-2-1`. Will post query snippets in the thread.
qa-liz: Summary will include pass/fail counts, top 10 mismatches, and structured-output diffs.
mira: OK — last ask: runtime, please confirm no kernel changes in the runtime that would break 3.2.1. @jonathan and @deploybot tag runtime-owner if needed.
jonathan: runtime-owner (cc runtime team) — can you confirm?
runtime-owner: quick check: no kernel-level changes scheduled in that window. A minor patch landed yesterday but it's opt-in and not enabled for canary clusters. All good from runtime side.
mira: Perfect. I'm going to proceed with the schedule. If anyone needs to opt out, file a sticky-pin request by 23:30 UTC today. Otherwise deploybot will proceed with soft-unpin at 02:00 UTC. :rotating_light:
samir: Thanks — we'll watch the dashboards and be ready to abort.
qa-liz: Uploaded report: /tmp/canary-3-2-1-summary.json — small diff on structured outputs (5 mismatches), latency unchanged. thumbs up from QA.
mira: Triage notes: 5 mismatches are expected tokenization differences; not blocking. proceeding.
deploybot: Execution started: soft-unpin job ns-561234 -> cohorts eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1. Live logs: https://internal-logs/deploy/ns-561234
jonathan: seeing initial rollout metrics — 95th latency +0.6% (within threshold), error rate stable.
samir: watching memory graphs. No OOMs.
ops-elena: CS notified for Dedicated customers in affected regions. Template used: "Planned compatibility test for SDK update in night window — tracking only."
mira: Thanks everyone. Will update if anything changes.
